2608.02685.title: BulkPR-Bench: Benchmarking Queue-Level Governance of Interacting Pull Requests
2608.02685.paper_summary: Coding-agent benchmarks increasingly cover long-horizon, end-to-end, and interactive development, but typically retain one requested outcome or a fixed change sequence. Sequential policies can process a pull-request (PR) queue one candidate at a time, but when queued PRs interact, maximizing safe delivery can require jointly deciding which changes to merge and in what order. We introduce BulkPR-Bench, an executable benchmark in which an agent must recover consequential PR relations and return a large safe subset in executable order under a rolling-release protocol. The suite contains 581 newly authored candidate PRs on frozen snapshots of 18 real repositories. Registered state-by-state repository execution, including hidden safety checks, validates the gold relation graph; an exact oracle then computes the largest safe subset. Our primary metric, Relational Delivery Score (RDS), scores safe delivery and correct rejection over relation groups from the realized merge trace; Global Safety-Gated Yield (Global-SGY) separately measures strict delivery of the realized whole-queue plan. Under the buffered primary protocol with batch size $K=32$, the three highest RDS estimates among the six models are 66.6%, 62.0%, and 57.9%, compared with 53.1% for the strongest sequential baseline. Only 8 of 324 model runs complete a queue exactly. Critical-relation recall ranges from 35.2% to 57.7%, and diagnostic runs supplied with the gold relations show substantial remaining headroom. Gains on relation groups therefore do not yet translate into dependable whole-queue governance.
2608.02685.paper_summary_zh: 編碼代理基準越來越多地涵蓋長期、端到端和互動開發，但通常保留一個請求的結果或固定的變更序列。序列策略可以一次處理一個候選者的拉取請求（PR）隊列，但當排隊的 PR 互動時，最大化安全交付可能需要共同決定合併哪些變更以及以什麼順序進行合併。我們介紹了 BulkPR-Bench，這是一個可執行的基準，其中代理必須恢復重要的 PR 關係並在滾動發佈協議下以可執行順序返回一個大型安全子集。該套件包含在 18 個真實代碼庫的凍結快照上新創建的 581 個候選 PR。註冊的逐州代碼庫執行，包括隱藏的安全檢查，驗證了金標關係圖；然後一個精確的預言機計算出最大的安全子集。我們的主要指標，關係交付分數（RDS），對從實現的合併追蹤中獲得的關係組的安全交付和正確拒絕進行評分；全球安全門控產量（Global-SGY）則單獨測量實現的整個隊列計劃的嚴格交付。在批量大小 $K=32$ 的緩衝主協議下，六個模型中最高的三個 RDS 估計分別為 66.6%、62.0% 和 57.9%，而最強的序列基線為 53.1%。在 324 次模型運行中，只有 8 次精確完成了一個隊列。關鍵關係的召回率範圍從 35.2% 到 57.7%，而提供金關係的診斷運行顯示出相當大的剩餘提升空間。因此，對關係組的增益尚未轉化為可靠的整個隊列治理。
